simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בִּרְזוֹת (H1269) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בִּרְזוֹת (Birzôwth) means Birzoth , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 7 31.

definitions.full: H1269. Birzoth ברזות proper name, feminine (?) descendant of Asher (perhaps בִּרְזָא foramen , Thes, or woman whose beauties are apparent ) 1Chr 7:31 Kt (Qr בִּרְזָ֑יִת ).
definitions.rootNote: probably feminine plural from an unused root (apparently mean to pierce); holes;
